start.title: [TODO:tr] Before the Teacher
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Pharisees push a trembling woman
before Jesus at the temple.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Anger does not see the heart.

join_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Hold Your Voice
join_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Loud voices drown out the truth.
Stand still and listen.

accusation.title: [TODO:tr] The Accusation
accusation.text:
[TODO:tr] "She was caught in sin," they cry.
The woman cannot lift her eyes.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Mercy begins with a gentle gaze.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Turn your eyes away in scorn
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She is still a soul before God.

scorn_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] See Her
scorn_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She is more than her shame.
Look with kindness.

trap.title: [TODO:tr] The Trap
trap.text:
[TODO:tr] "The law says stone her.
What do you say, teacher?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Wisdom answers in its own time.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wait in silence for his answer

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Patient
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He hears every word, even the silent.
Wait for him.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wait in silence for his answer

side_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Mercy Too
side_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The law is true, but so is mercy.
Hear them both.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wait in silence for his answer

writing.title: [TODO:tr] He Stoops Low
writing.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus bends and writes in the dust,
as if he heard nothing at all.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] His quiet speaks louder than shouts.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Watch his finger trace the ground

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Look Closer
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His silence carries weight.
Look and learn.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Watch his finger trace the ground

without_sin.title: [TODO:tr] Without Sin
without_sin.text:
[TODO:tr] He stands. "Let him without sin
cast the first stone."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Reach for a stone in pride

stone_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Lay It Down
stone_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Your own faults rise to mind.
Let the stone fall.

fool_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Look Inside
fool_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Mercy is the wisdom of God.
Search yourself first.

accusers_leave.title: [TODO:tr] One by One
accusers_leave.text:
[TODO:tr] The oldest leaves first. Then another.
Stones fall from open hands.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Stay and see what love does.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Stay and See
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Mercy is about to speak.
Do not miss this.

mercy.title: [TODO:tr] Neither Do I
mercy.text:
[TODO:tr] "Has no one condemned you?"
"No one, Lord," she whispers.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Mercy is the beginning of life.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Trust the Gift
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His mercy holds and changes you.
Receive it.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] Go and Sin No More
ending.text:
[TODO:tr] "Neither do I condemn you.
Go, and sin no more."
